flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: FurnishApprovalHelper (hirer becomes offender, furnished_mail address, stage RD1), ToppanLettersGeneratorJob + ToppanUploadJob + ToppanUploadHelper (select RD1, filter letter_address, build file, update stage), OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.findToppanNoticesForStage, AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl (fixed-width file format), ComcryptUploadProcessor + SftpUtil (SFTP delivery, blocked by config), application-{dev,uat,prod}.properties and cron-schedules-prod.properties. Other repos: no relevant code for letter delivery
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark: SFTP, code split, SFTP permission for the api App Service. This is the hirer version of OCMS11.7 (owner): the Toppan RD1 flow is the same, the difference is that the processed notice is one that was just furnished, where the hirer becomes the offender and the owner-given address becomes the letter_address. The Toppan Upload cron at 00:15 (enabled in prod) selects RD1 notices, fills the address, builds a fixed-width data file (PDF only for ANL), puts it in Azure Blob and requests COMCRYPT encryption. The core of the story (the file reaching the vendor) is blocked by config: sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in dev, uat, prod (application-prod.properties:86). While the block is active the stage still advances to RD2 through the delivery gate bypass (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-446), so the hirer may not receive the 1st letter without a resend. Tickets as hints: OCMS-DF-2026-170, OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT, not in prod). From reading the code, the letter_address reset after the first letter does not know furnished_mail (to verify). Toppan service, COMCRYPT, SFTP, property values in Azure, and the SFTP permission of the App Service: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Partial claim: the RD1 file for the hirer is built, but SFTP delivery to the vendor is blocked by config and the stage still advances while the block is active

steps.step: The hirer furnished by the owner is recorded as the active offender (the fine is no longer against the owner) and the notice is ready for the 1st letter (RD1)
steps.detail: When the furnish is approved, the old offender_indicator is changed to N and an owner_driver record with role H and offender_indicator Y is created, with name, ID, email and phone from the furnish application (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:542-575, 713-745). changeProcessingStage sets last and next processing stage = RD1 with next_processing_date = max(notice_date + 7 days, tomorrow) (644-690), so the notice enters the 1st letter reminder queue under the hirer. The same facts are assessed in OCMS11.26 (steps 6 and 7).

steps.step: The daily Toppan cron selects the NOPOs due for the 1st letter (next stage RD1, due, not suspended)
steps.detail: The Toppan Upload cron runs at 00:15 and is enabled in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62). findToppanNoticesForStage selects next_processing_stage = 'RD1', next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type IS NULL, offender_indicator 'Y' (so the newly furnished hirer), and not an Advisory Notice (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:596-614), called through ToppanUploadHelper.java:1887 from ToppanUploadJob.java:248. Same as OCMS11.7 step 2. Double check: the 00:15 schedule (process_dayend_jobs) exists and is enabled, but the call to toppanLettersGeneratorService.executeJob() in ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.executeDayEndJobs (line 119) is commented out, so letter generation only runs through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters. Rated Partial.

steps.step: The letter is addressed to the address given by the vehicle owner (furnished_mail, letter_address = Y); NOPOs without an address are skipped
steps.detail: processFurnishedAddress stores the owner-given address as type_of_address 'furnished_mail' with letter_address 'Y' and clears the old offender's letter_address (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:601-636). Before the file is built, filterByLetterAddress only lets through notices that have a letter_address 'Y' row and overwrites the notice address fields with that row; notices without such a row are dropped (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2372-2400, 2428-2460; called at ToppanUploadJob.java:266). So the RD1 letter for the hirer uses the owner-given address, not the owner's own address. Same as OCMS11.7 step 3.

steps.step: OCMS builds a data file (PDF/data format) with the letter details for the vendor to print
steps.detail: File name URA-DPT-RD1-D1-<timestamp> (ToppanUploadJob.java:279-281); the content is built by createToppanRequestFileContent: header 'H' with run date/time and fixed-width detail records of 719 characters per notice, sorted by postal code (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:564-603). A PDF is only generated for the ANL stage (ToppanUploadJob.java:322-340), so for RD1 the vendor prints from the data file, which matches the story option 'PDF/data files'. Same as OCMS11.7 step 4.

steps.step: The file is stored in Azure Blob and COMCRYPT encryption is requested so it can be sent to the vendor
steps.detail: The original file is uploaded to Azure Blob through uploadToBlob (ToppanUploadJob.java:311-316), then comcryptTokenHelper.requestToken asks for encryption (346-353); the COMCRYPT callback puts the encrypted file on the SFTP. The COMCRYPT service and its encrypted output: cannot verify from repo. Same as OCMS11.7 step 5.

steps.step: The encrypted file is sent to the vendor (Toppan) by SFTP
steps.detail: The sending code exists (COMCRYPT callback to SFTP), but sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in prod, uat and dev (application-prod.properties:86; application-uat.properties:77; application-dev.properties:77). SftpUtil.isServerUploadDisabled (SftpUtil.java:111-113) makes ComcryptUploadProcessor throw SftpDisabledException and keep the operation record (ComcryptUploadProcessor.java:206-209), so the RD1 file does not reach Toppan while that property is present. The properties comment cites OCMS-DF-2026-170; OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT) explains the effect on the stage. Whether the block is lifted in Azure prod, the Toppan SFTP service, and the SFTP permission for the App Service as in the demo_remark: cannot verify from repo. Same as OCMS11.7 step 6.

steps.step: After sending, the notice moves to the next stage (RD2) and is recorded as having received the 1st letter
steps.detail: After delivery is confirmed, updateProcessingStage sets last stage RD1, next stage RD2 with the duration in days, amount_payable, and admin fee 0 at non-RR3/DR3 stages (fix OCMS-DF-2026-170), then records the tracking table and letter_address (ToppanUploadHelper.java:235-330, 1366-1421). Partial because when SFTP is blocked, the delivery gate is bypassed (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-446): the stage still advances to RD2 and the notice is treated as mailed although the file was not delivered, so the hirer can miss the 1st letter without a resend; OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT) still awaits business confirmation for this behaviour. To verify, from reading the code: resetLetterAddressAfterToppan only picks mha_reg, lta_reg, lta_mail (ToppanUploadHelper.java:468-520), not furnished_mail, so the owner-given address of the hirer may stop being the letter address after the first letter. Same as OCMS11.7 step 7.
